description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git's merge-recursive functionality, particularly focusing on rename detection and threshold configurations for detecting renames during merges. It contains setup commands, test cases, and assertions to verify Git's behavior with different rename detection thresholds and options.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Sets up Git stages for a specific renamed file to verify detection of renames in tests.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks whether renames are detected for a specific file based on expected stages.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Checks whether renames are not detected for a specific file based on expected stages.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Verifies the number of staged files in Git to match expected count.

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Verifies that no renames are detected.
